company.name: Fly.io
company.shortDescription: Fly.io provides a cloud platform for deploying, running, and scaling applications, databases, and AI workloads globally.
company.description: Fly.io provides a cloud platform for deploying, running, and scaling applications, databases, and AI workloads. The platform supports containerized applications, virtual machines, managed PostgreSQL databases, object storage, private networking, and GPU-enabled workloads, enabling developers to run services across distributed infrastructure.

productsAndServices.description: Hardware-virtualized containers with a REST API that run any Docker image on a global cloud across 35 regions, scalable from single HTTP requests to long uptime.
productsAndServices.name: Fly Machines

productsAndServices.description: Dynamic request routing that directs each user or robot to their own dedicated sandbox using Fly Proxy and fly-replay.
productsAndServices.name: User-Specific Routing

productsAndServices.description: Dedicated storage solutions for users or robots including Fly Volumes, Fly Managed Postgres, and S3-compatible Tigris Data.
productsAndServices.name: Persistent Storage

productsAndServices.description: Remote Model Context Protocol servers built on Fly Machines to integrate sandboxes into large language model workflows.
productsAndServices.name: MCP Servers

productsAndServices.description: Paid support services offering access to engineers who use the platform, including emergency support and guaranteed response times.
productsAndServices.name: Developer Support Packages
